name: Wrist extensor stretch
summary: Arm straight out, palm down, press the back of the hand down and toward you.
setup: Straighten the arm in front, palm down, fingers relaxed. With the other hand, press the back of the hand down and toward the body until the top of the forearm stretches. Hold.
why: The stretch is at the hand. Logged by hand.

faults.label: Elbow bending
faults.tip: A bent elbow takes the stretch off the forearm.

faults.label: Shoulder rising
faults.tip: Keep the shoulder relaxed so the stretch stays in the forearm.

faults.label: Bouncing the stretch
faults.tip: Steady and gentle. This tendon is usually already irritable.

faults.label: Open hand
faults.tip: A gentle fist adds the finger extensors to the stretch.

points.t: Straight, palm down, hand pressed down.
